answer: Bind each earning identity to a public library card. The member shows photo ID at the desk once; the economy then asks the library's patron service for a signed yes/no that the card is active, and stores only a salted hash of the card number, not a reversible cipher, so one card unlocks one identity. A farm needs a separate in-person visit and real ID per fake, a cost splitting cannot share. An expired card becomes a relic and stops rewards. Limit: libraries vary, so a branch caught issuing bulk cards loses its quartz-solid trust.
